history.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report
history.motion: A motion was made by Vice President Gonzales, seconded by President London, to Approve the General Consent Report. The motion carried by the following vote

items.text: Adoption by the Board of Education, as the Governing Authority of the Oakland Unified School District,  of the Verification of Closure of Early Learning and Childcare (ELC) Programs; certifying that said Programs have been closed for in-person instruction due to a local or state public health order or guidance and by order of the Board since March 2020, due to COVID-19;  that at some point the Board will discuss in a Public Hearing the ELC Program closure and will prepare a plan for safely reopening the ELC Program no later than when the District campuses reopens for in-person instruction; authorizes the President of the Board to execute said Verification on behalf of the Board, as required by CA SB 820 and Education Code Section 8209;  and further authorize the Superintendent of Schools or designee to transmit said Verification to the California Department of Education forthwith.
items.title: Early Childhood Education Verification of Closure Form - Governing Authority of the District
